title: Determine range of values
text: Angles in the third quadrant have infinitely many possible descriptions. We might have pi< $$\theta$$ <(3pi)/2, or we might have $$\pi+2\pi$$ $$k$$ < $$\theta$$ <(3pi)/2+2pi $$k$$ for $$k$$ some integer value. This is because we could wind any number of times around the circle first before landing at the angle.
